parameters.help_en:
The UUID of the server on which you want to install the anti-ransomware client.

You can call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~) operation to obtain this value. UuidList and Uuid cannot both be empty
parameters.help_zh:
要安装防勒索客户端的服务器的UUID。

您可调用[DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~)接口获取该数据。UuidList和Uuid不能同时为空
parameters.name: uuid

parameters.help_en:
The version of the mitigation policies. Valid values:

1.0.0: The version of the mitigation policies is 1.0.0.
2.0.0: The version of the mitigation policies is 2.0.0
parameters.help_zh:
防护策略的版本。取值：

1.0.0：表示防护策略的版本为1.0.0版本
2.0.0：表示防护策略的版本为2.0.0版本
parameters.name: policy_version

parameters.help_en:
The list of UUIDs of the servers that you want to protect.
Call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
需要防护的服务器UUID列表。
调用[DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: uuid_list

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
